sloka: ताम् हि वज्रसमाम् वाचमाकर्ण्य हृदया प्रियाम् ।दुःखशोकमयीम् घोराम् राजा न सुखितोऽभवत् ॥२-१२-५३॥
transliteration: tām hi vajrasamām vācamākarṇya hṛdayā priyām ।duḥkhaśokamayīm ghorām rājā na sukhito'bhavat ॥2-12-53॥

translations.english: The unhappy king intently fixed his gaze at his beloved queen speaking unpleasant words charged with grief and anguish, unpleasant to the heart like the dreadful thunderbolt.
